node.title: Re: Where is Data::Dumper->Dumpx?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
What ever happened to Dumpx? It does not appear to be in that module.

A search of the git history of the Perl core seems to show that there never was a Dumpx function - only Dumpxs, so it might just be a typo in the book. Dumpxs is still there, but as [choroba] already [id://1208756|pointed out], [doc://Data::Dumper] defaults to the XS implementation (maybe it didn't in the past), so you normally don't have to worry about it.

$ perl -MData::Dumper -e 'print Data::Dumper->new(["foo"])->Dumpxs' $VAR1 = 'foo';
